items.title: Jensen Huang’s Return Doesn’t Make Nvidia Stock (NVDA) a Buy
items.summary: Jensen Huang’s return as CEO doesn’t make Nvidia (NVDA) stock a Buy, despite the market’s positive reaction. Shares of the leading semiconductor manufacturer jumped roughly 31.5% on November 23 after Nvidia’s board unanimously reinstated Huang with immediate effect. Yet the stock remains down roughly 31% over the past month following a steep sell-off.
